notablePrerequisites:
Savage Ventmaw does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
description:
Declare Radha, Hellkite Charger and Savage Ventmaw as attackers.
Radha, Savage Ventmaw and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding at least {3}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
